title: Vintage Playboy Magazine April 1964 Ashlyn Martin Center - Complete - See Pics
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Playboy Magazine from April 1964 featuring Ashlyn Martin on the centerfold. This illustrated magazine is in English and was published monthly in the United States. The magazine covers a range of topics including women, art & photography, and men, making it a valuable collectible for those interested in vintage magazines and classic photography.
